Decision or follow-up: Not fixed. The fix is to give the shared assertion the same recovery semantics GC-HARNESS-061 applies in the browser-action lane, so a reconnect that completes within its deadline cannot fail an unrelated scenario. Deferred because it would mint a new candidate SHA and require a full recertification, and because it would not address the separate GC-ENV-007 route-ready timeouts.
